supporting_scope: Polynomial matrix/quaternion representations and their actual infinitesimal actions
script_version_note: The script fingerprint identifies the exact checked text; it includes a final numeral-coercion proof correction made after the mathematical source commit.
scope: Exact all-degree SC2 signature and small correspondence checks: column substitution, action order and group inverse, genuine analytic differential, i/j/k conventions, real scalars, quaternion left multiplication, unnormalized T_n, C_v, n=1 factors, and nonzero connection contribution for q=1,p=X. Author correspondence checks, not independent review.
output:
MathResearch.Spinor.polynomialRepresentation (n : ℕ) : Representation ℂ Matrix2 ↥(BinaryForm n)
MathResearch.Spinor.generalLinearPolynomialRepresentation (n : ℕ) : Representation ℂ (GL (Fin 2) ℂ) ↥(BinaryForm n)
MathResearch.Spinor.polynomialRepresentation_hasDerivAt (m : ℕ) (M : Matrix2) (p : ↥(BinaryForm (m + 1))) :
  HasDerivAt (fun (t : ℂ) => ((polynomialRepresentation (m + 1)) (1 + t • M)) p) ((infinitesimalAction m M) p) 0
MathResearch.Spinor.quaternionPolynomialRepresentation_hasDerivAt (m : ℕ) (v : ℍ) (p : ↥(BinaryForm (m + 1))) :
  HasDerivAt (fun (t : ℝ) => ((quaternionPolynomialRepresentation (m + 1)) (1 + t • v)) p)
    ((infinitesimalAction m (quaternionMatrix v)) p) 0
MathResearch.Spinor.infinitesimal_commutator (M N : Matrix2) (p : ComplexPoly2) :
  infinitesimal M (infinitesimal N p) - infinitesimal N (infinitesimal M p) = infinitesimal (M * N - N * M) p
MathResearch.Spinor.quaternionMatrixHom : ℍ →ₐ[ℝ] Matrix2
MathResearch.Spinor.quaternionMatrix_pack (q : ℍ) (a b : ℂ) :
  pack (quaternionMatrix q 0 0 * a + quaternionMatrix q 0 1 * b)
      (quaternionMatrix q 1 0 * a + quaternionMatrix q 1 1 * b) =
    q * pack a b
MathResearch.Spinor.SC2_v1 (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (q : ℍ) (p : ↥(BinaryForm n)) :
  ((fun (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) =>
        ∑ μ : Fin 4,
          MathResearch.Fueter.coordinateBasis μ *
            polynomialFueterCoefficients
              (infinitesimal (quaternionMatrix (star (MathResearch.Fueter.coordinateBasis μ) * q)) ↑p) d) =
      fun (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) => (2 * (↑n + 1)) • (q * polynomialFueterCoefficients (↑p) d)) ∧
    (fun (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) =>
        ∑ μ : Fin 4,
          MathResearch.Fueter.coordinateBasis μ *
            polynomialFueterCoefficients
              (infinitesimal (quaternionMatrix (connectionCoefficient q (MathResearch.Fueter.coordinateBasis μ))) ↑p)
              d) =
      fun (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) => (↑n + 2) • (q * polynomialFueterCoefficients (↑p) d)
'MathResearch.Spinor.SC2_v1' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'MathResearch.Spinor.polynomialRepresentation_hasDerivAt' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
